title: 350z/G35 LHD LSx Engine Mounts
description:
Sikky motor mounts are CAD/CAM designed and CNC machined using solid 6061 T-6 aluminum and include a high grade hardware kit.



Get proper engine placement and driveshaft alignment. Peace of mind comes from Sikky’s Limited Lifetime Warranty.



Can be used on LS1, LS2, LS3, LS6, L99, LQ4, LQ9, LSA, LS7, LS9, LSX and any other LS based engine using this engine mount bolt pattern.



For correct fitment be sure to use with Sikky Engine Mount Bushings, Oil Pan, and Transmission Cross member



Includes:

\-Billet Motor mount (left)

\-Billet Motor mount (right)

\-High grade hardware
